name: Get a segment
description: Get the name and filter of one segment by id. Use before editing or reusing its filter.

fe_query.description: Filter tree. An 'or' list of groups; each group has an 'and' list of conditions. A condition is {contact: {field, dataType, operator, value: [..]}, isValidated: true}. Valid fields and data types come from segments.list_filterable_fields.

execution.auth: Cookie session of the logged-in app.brevo.com user, sent with the request (fetch credentials: include). No API key. Replayed from inside the app page only; behavior from outside a browser (CSRF, CORS, session expiry) was not tested.

verification.notes: Observed in UI traffic, then replayed from inside the logged-in page.
